documented_facts.rt1060_manual_purpose: parts returned from shipped products; fuse burning protected by a CSF command
documented_facts.rt1061_nxp_community_closed_config: SEC_CONFIG_CLOSED 0x00000002: image executes only if authenticated
documented_facts.imx7d_support_warning: NXP support describes field-return as factory-return test mode; it can void programmed keys and that specific i.MX7D case did not boot

reason: Do not treat FIELD_RETURN as a routine developer unlock. It is a one-way eFuse state change intended for returned-part testing; the exact RT1061 behavior and a safe recovery path have not been established.
